examStructure.label: Sections
examStructure.value: Core, Type I, Type II, Type III

examStructure.label: Format
examStructure.value: Closed book — except Type I, which may be open book

examStructure.label: Retakes
examStructure.value: Only failed sections need to be retaken

examStructure.label: Validity
examStructure.value: Certification does not expire once earned

examStructure.label: Prerequisite
examStructure.value: Core must be passed to earn any Type or Universal credential

keyDates.label: July 1, 1992
keyDates.value: Production and import prohibition begins for CFCs and HCFCs

keyDates.label: November 15, 1993
keyDates.value: Cut-off date separating recovery-equipment / evacuation-level requirements

recoveryType1.label: Pre-Nov 15, 1993 equipment
recoveryType1.value: 80% recovery (compressor working or not), or evacuate to 4 in. Hg

recoveryType1.label: Post-Nov 15, 1993 equipment, compressor working
recoveryType1.value: 90% recovery, or evacuate to 4 in. Hg

recoveryType1.label: Post-Nov 15, 1993 equipment, compressor not working
recoveryType1.value: 80% recovery, or evacuate to 4 in. Hg

evacuationLevels.label: Type II — 200 lbs or more (post-1993 equipment)
Type II — very-high-pressure blends (R-410A, R-404A, R-507)

threeRs.label: Recovery
threeRs.value: Removing refrigerant from a system in any condition and storing it in an external container, without necessarily testing or processing it.

threeRs.label: Recycling
threeRs.value: Reducing contaminants (moisture, acid, particulates) for reuse, typically on-site, without meeting new-product purity.

threeRs.label: Reclamation
threeRs.value: Reprocessing to the AHRI 700 purity standard, verified by chemical analysis, usually at an off-site facility, so it can be sold as new product.

leakRepair.label: Retrofit/retire alternative
leakRepair.value: Must be documented on-site and completed within 1 year

leakRepair.label: Mandatory leak-rate trigger applies to
leakRepair.value: Appliances with a full charge of 50 lbs or more

unitTraps.label: Type II unit
unitTraps.value: Inches of mercury (in. Hg) vacuum, gauge pressure

unitTraps.label: Type III unit
unitTraps.value: Millimeters of mercury (mm Hg), absolute pressure

unitTraps.label: Why it matters
unitTraps.value: The exam frequently swaps these units between near-identical answer choices — read the unit before the number.
